title: Typed Projection Transition Rules
purpose: Define the lawful transitions from the affect/effect domain into the projection domain, especially A|E -> Π_D(A|E) -> D(*|*).
core_claim: Projection is a typed domain transition, not an unguarded substitution.

canonical_claims.statement: Projection is a typed domain transition, not an unguarded substitution.
Π_D(A|E) and D(*|*) belong to TYPE_PROJECTION.
A transition from A|E to D(*|*) is lawful only through Π_D.
Projection preserves representable distinction while not exhausting the primitive affect/effect condition.

formal_objects.name: Typed Projection Transition Rules
formal_objects.definition: Lawful typed transitions from the affect/effect domain into the projection domain, especially A|E -> Π_D(A|E) -> D(*|*).

typed_transition_rules.name: Affect/Effect to Projection Transition
typed_transition_rules.condition: Only if Π_D is explicitly invoked.

typed_transition_rules.name: No Direct Collapse
typed_transition_rules.meaning: The primitive condition must not be collapsed into its projection.

validation_requirements: No direct substitution of A|E for D(*|*) allowed.
